      name: '@chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization'

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | 中文

一个给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）用的 bundle 插件包，装好后提供一个 skill：**`cpp-opt-audit`**，用于审查或编写「又快又安全」的底层 C++ 代码。

它的核心约束是**先确认目标工程真实的 C++ 标准**：探测不到就问用户，标准确认之前不推荐、不写入任何高于该标准的特性。结论全部带着「检查点 / 为什么 / 反例→正例 / 适用标准」四要素。

用 dsh CLI 装到指定 profile：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization
```

`--profile` 填要装到的 profile（这里按 web 写，`tui` 同理）；`desktop` profile 由桌面应用独占管理，命令行 `dsh plugin` 会拒绝，请改用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`。`dsh plugin` 之后的参数会原样交给 pnpm，所以从本地目录安装时把包名换成目录的绝对路径即可：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库目录的绝对路径>
```

本包是 bundle 插件：安装时会写入该 profile 的包依赖，并选中本包的 `cordis.patch.yml`。**不要手动改 profile 的 `package.json` 或 `cordis.patch.yml`，也不要在 profile 目录里跑 pnpm。**

备选方式：在 DSH 会话里让智能体用 `plugin_manager` 工具的 `install_bundle` 动作安装，`target` 同样传包名或目录的绝对路径。

安装后无需重启即可在会话目录里看到 `cpp-opt-audit`；如果替换了已安装的同名包，需要重启以加载新的模块。

- 模型自动触发：任务涉及 C++ 代码审查、优化、底层实现时，会话目录会提示模型先加载该 skill。
- 用户显式调用：直接输入 `/cpp-opt-audit`。

skill 的工作方式是**两阶段**：阶段 0–3 只读审查并输出带证据的报告，阶段 4 才在得到同意后改代码。

```
assets/cpp-opt-audit/
├── SKILL.md                          # 入口：硬规则、入口选择、五阶段工作流（0–4）、九维判据速查表、高频检查点
└── references/
    ├── standard-detection.md         # 标准探测步骤、__cplusplus 校验、17/20/23 降级映射

九个维度（类型安全、ABI 与接口设计合为一个维度）对应十个维度文件，每条标注适用标准；两个横向参考不按维度切分，分别负责「从症状反查候选成因」和「把结论变成可验证的证据」；各文件末尾单列了尚未覆盖的主题，避免把「没查到」当成「没问题」。

readme.section: 作为纯文件 skill 使用
readme.text:
不想装插件时，把 `assets/cpp-opt-audit/` 整个目录复制到 skill 扫描根即可，例如：

- 用户级：`~/.dsh/skills/cpp-opt-audit/`
- 项目级：`<工程根>/.dsh/skills/cpp-opt-audit/`

目录名即 skill 名，`SKILL.md` 的 frontmatter 会被自动解析。

本包是 Host-only bundle：零运行时依赖、无构建步骤，`index.js` 直接作为入口导出 `apply`/`inject`/`name`。

```bash
node --check index.js                                  # 语法检查
node -e "import('./index.js').then(m => console.log(m.name, m.inject))"
npm test                                                # 运行插件契约测试
```

`npm test` 会走 `node --test` 并启动子进程；在限制子进程的环境（例如部分沙箱）里，改为逐个运行 `node test/provider.test.mjs`、`node test/package-manifest.test.mjs`。

插件在 `apply(ctx)` 里用 `ctx.skills.registerProvider(...)` 注册一个提供方，`list()` 解析 `SKILL.md` 的 frontmatter 生成目录条目，`get()` 每次重新读取正文（因此编辑 skill 内容无需重新安装）。

改 frontmatter 时注意格式：`name` 必须是单行 `name: cpp-opt-audit`，`description` 支持单行、`description: >`（折叠为一段）与 `description: |`（保留换行）三种写法。写成其他形式（例如 `description` 后直接换行却不给 `>` / `|`）会让插件在加载期直接报错，并提示可用写法。

```bash
npm publish --access public
```

发布前核对 `package.json` 中的 `repository`/`homepage`/`bugs` 与 `files` 清单，并用 `npm pack --dry-run` 确认包内文件与版本号。
MIT

English | [中文](README.md)

A bundle plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) that ships one skill, **`cpp-opt-audit`**, for auditing or writing fast *and* safe low-level C++.

Its central constraint is that the **target project's actual C++ standard is detected first**: when detection fails the skill asks the user, and until the standard is confirmed it never recommends or writes a feature newer than that standard. Every finding carries a checkpoint, a reason, a bad→good code pair, and the minimum standard.

Install it into a profile with the dsh CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @chtholly-fan/dsh-cpp-optimization
```

`--profile` picks the profile to install into (web here; `tui` works the same), while `desktop` is managed exclusively by the desktop app — the CLI rejects it, so use `plugin_manager`'s `install_bundle` instead. Everything after `dsh plugin` is passed straight to pnpm — so to install from a local checkout, pass the directory's absolute path instead of the package name:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add <absolute path of this repository>
```

This is a bundle plugin: installation writes the profile's package dependency and selects this package's `cordis.patch.yml`. Do not edit the profile's `package.json` or `cordis.patch.yml` by hand, and do not run pnpm inside the profile directory.

Alternative: ask the agent in a DSH session to install it with the `plugin_manager` tool's `install_bundle` action, passing the package name or the directory's absolute path as `target`.

The skill appears in the session catalog without a restart; replacing an already installed copy of the package requires a restart to load the new module.

- Automatic: whenever a task touches C++ review, optimization, or low-level implementation, the catalog tells the model to load the skill first.
- Explicit: type `/cpp-opt-audit`.

The skill works in two phases: stages 0–3 audit read-only and report findings with evidence, while stage 4 edits code only after you agree.

```
assets/cpp-opt-audit/
├── SKILL.md                          # rules, entry routing, five-phase workflow (stages 0–4), nine-dimension quick table, top checkpoints
└── references/
    ├── standard-detection.md         # standard detection, __cplusplus checks, C++17/20/23 downgrades

Checkpoints are grouped into nine dimensions (type safety, ABI and interface design form one dimension), which map to ten checkpoint files; each names its minimum standard. Two cross-cutting references are not split by dimension: one goes from symptoms to candidate causes, the other turns conclusions into verifiable evidence. Every file lists the topics that are not covered yet.

readme.section: Use as a plain filesystem skill
readme.text: Without installing the plugin, copy `assets/cpp-opt-audit/` into any scanned skill root, for example `~/.dsh/skills/cpp-opt-audit/` or `<project>/.dsh/skills/cpp-opt-audit/`. The directory name is the skill name.

Host-only bundle: no runtime dependencies and no build step. `index.js` exports `apply`, `inject`, and `name` directly.

```bash
node --check index.js
node -e "import('./index.js').then(m => console.log(m.name, m.inject))"
npm test
```

`npm test` runs `node --test`, which spawns child processes; where child processes are restricted (for example inside some sandboxes), run `node test/provider.test.mjs` and `node test/package-manifest.test.mjs` individually.

`apply(ctx)` registers a provider through `ctx.skills.registerProvider(...)`. `list()` parses the `SKILL.md` frontmatter into a catalog entry, and `get()` re-reads the body on every load, so editing skill content needs no reinstall.

Keep the frontmatter in a supported shape: `name` stays on one line as `name: cpp-opt-audit`, and `description` accepts a single line, a `description: >` folded block, or a `description: |` literal block. Any other form makes the plugin fail at load time with a message listing the accepted shapes.

```bash
npm publish --access public
```

Before publishing, check `repository`/`homepage`/`bugs` and the `files` list in `package.json`, and confirm the tarball contents and version with `npm pack --dry-run`.
MIT
